scenes.text: It was nearly bedtime, and {NAME} the little child sat by the window with a soft, sleepy {ANIMAL}.
The moon was big and round and smiling. "Time to rest," it whispered. "Time to rest."
{NAME} and the {ANIMAL} tiptoed out into the quiet garden, where the flowers were folding their petals.
A little breeze hummed a slow song. The {ANIMAL} yawned a very big yawn, and {NAME} yawned too.
They found a cloud as soft as a pillow, floating just above the grass. "Time to rest," it whispered.
{NAME} and the {ANIMAL} climbed on, and the cloud carried them gently over the hills and the sleepy sea.
The moon smiled once more. "Time to rest," it whispered. And {NAME} closed their eyes, safe and cozy, and fell fast asleep. Goodnight, {NAME}.
